主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on March 15, 2013, announcing the date for the spin-off of Brookfield Property Partners. The filing is part of the company's regulatory disclosures and includes incorporation by reference to its registration statement on Form F-9. The document outlines the company's compliance with U.S. securities regulations and includes the signature of B. D. Lawson, Managing Partner & CFO. The spin-off of Brookfield Property Partners is a significant corporate action that reflects the company's strategic restructuring and diversification efforts.
